rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=3, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=iter-7 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: proj_n_bf 1 -> 3 (projection-domain trainable-bilateral DEPTH; params 6 -> 12 via 3*(proj_n_bf+img_n_bf)=3*(3+1)). OFF iter-1 base (best config: lr 5e-3, img_n_bf 1, proj_sr 0.02, proj_kernel 5 -- the untouched warm-start-anchored baseline). PER-IMAGE preserved (warm-start amortized pre-pass on 4 train patients -> generic BF-sigma init, then INDEPENDENT per-scan Adam fit on EACH L277 slice OWN half-angle measurements, GT-free; NEVER amortized; warm_start=True, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 lr5e-3 proj_sr0.02 proj_n_bf1 proj_kernel5 -> SSIM 0.92477 / PSNR 34.033 / RMSE 9.938e-4 / hr 0 / 940.4s (HIGHEST raw SSIM of the run); iter-2 proj_sr0.02->0.0005 -> SSIM 0.92473 / hr 0 / 924.1s (proj_sr INERT, falsifier fired -- RETIRED); iter-3 lr5e-3->3e-4 -> SSIM 0.92142 / hr 0 (lr-down REGRESSED); iter-4 img_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.89748 / hr 0 (image-domain depth REGRESSED hard); iter-5 proj_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.92468 / hr 0 / 1062.7s (proj-depth +1 mild regress); iter-6 proj_kernel5->7 -> SSIM 0.924766 / hr 0 / 994.5s (proj-spatial-footprint FLAT). Best hr 0.0 throughout. (2) LIMITER = 6-param trainable-bilateral CAPACITY CEILING on dense-view 2304-view Mayo: highest raw SSIM of any Mayo inference solver yet PSNR sits BELOW the LD-FBP floor -> hr 0. Confirmed-dead: proj_sr (inert iter-2), per-scan lr-down (regressed iter-3), image-domain img_n_bf-up (regressed iter-4), proj_kernel (flat iter-6). The +1 proj-depth step (iter-5) was too small to settle the proj-domain capacity question. (3) ONE KNOB = proj_n_bf 1->3: proj_sr is RETIRED (inert) so per the documented Mayo lever-fallback I push proj-domain DEPTH decisively. iter-5 probed only 1->2 (mild regress); a 1->3 step (off the iter-1 best base, NOT off iter-5) gives the lever-side proj domain enough DOF to settle whether ANY proj-domain capacity clears the FBP floor. proj domain is the established Mayo bilateral lever-SIDE (iter-2 proved image-domain sigma inert); image-domain depth regressed (iter-4), so proj-depth is the last unmapped capacity axis. (4) HYPOTHESIS: two added projection-domain bilateral layers denoise the dense 2304-view sinogram BEFORE backprojection with enough DOF to drop RMSE -> PSNR clears the LD-FBP floor -> hr rises above 0 (predict hr ~0.0-0.05). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr stays 0 (SSIM <= 0.9248, PSNR <= 34.03, no RMSE drop) at proj_n_bf=3, the trainable-bilateral N2I is STRUCTURALLY CAPPED on dense-view Mayo regardless of proj-domain depth -- every per-image knob (proj_sr, lr, img_n_bf, proj_n_bf, proj_kernel) retired, structural-ceiling verdict FILED: only the U-Net N2I real-denoiser capacity clears the FBP floor here (half-view N2I info loss < full-view LD-FBP). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): proj_n_bf 1->3 adds 2 proj-domain BF fwd+bwd per Adam step; dominant cost is the 2304-view FBP adjoint (FLAT in proj_n_bf). iter-5 at proj_n_bf=2 ran 1062.7s; +1 more proj layer ~+100s -> expect ~1160s = ~19.3 min, inside the 1200s wall. n_iter=30, val=ALL 214, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY, lr/img_n_bf/proj_sr/proj_kernel reverted to iter-1. in-solver outer_wall_s=1050 (17.5 min) backstop GUARANTEES a recorded result even if some slices run long. (6) HARD 20-min budget; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (NOT reduced); PER-IMAGE preserved (warm_start True, grad_clip 1.0, img_sr 0.02 NOT tightened). Do NOT return control mid-campaign. PREDICTED iter-7: hr ~0.0-0.05 if proj-domain capacity helps; hr<=0 falsifies (bilateral structurally capped on Mayo regardless of domain, only U-Net N2I works).
